LESSON: SIGN READING 12.2.1 FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.2: Sign Reading 12.2.1 Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 12.2.1 Fluency, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we need to pronounce and articulate signs with correct mouth movement Of words correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 12.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy: Interacting with digital technology as the learner sign reads a text from a digital device and picks out words with target letter- sounds.

●Self-efficacy: as the learner practises sign reading to acquire fluency.

Values:
Unity: as the learner cooperates with others in group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Learner support programmes: Clubs and Societies as the learner engages in Sign Reading clubs to practise Sign Reading fluency.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Sign Reading a variety of texts fluently is sign language.

Suggested Learning Resources

Chart, Class readers, Adapted Course books, Flash cards, Recording devices e.g tablets, mobile phone, Dictionary, Internet, Audio-visual recordings,

Posters, Pictures and Photographs, Extracts from newspapers, magazines.
